issues.finding: The source says multiple computation paths still have a single value without qualifying that a normal form must be reached. Church--Rosser gives uniqueness of a normal form if one exists; it does not prove termination.
issues.proposed_resolution: State that all reached normal forms agree, while retaining the later explicit if-any qualification.

issues.finding: The proof's two terminal chains end at N_(m,0) and N_(0,n), which the boundary assignments identify as P_m and Q_n. The frozen prose instead calls them P and Q without defining those endpoint symbols.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use P_m and Q_n in the target, and clarify that the interior diamond construction uses the upper-left predecessor; preserve frozen source bytes.

translation_treatment: The target translates the section, qualifies the value-uniqueness claim, identifies the indexed proof endpoints, and names the common predecessor for each interior diamond. The inherited OLP-0362 proof gap remains a separate reader-release dependency.
